name: Pact of the Black Tide
storyline:
Seventeen-year-old Clara Delanay arrives in Driftwood Bay, a coastal town in Oregon. She left her hometown after her mother, suffering from unexplained dementia, revealed the existence of a long-lost sister: Evelyn Delanay, who lives in Driftwood Bay. There, she learns that Evelyn has been dead for several years, but that Clara could inherit her mansion.

Exploring the town and its surroundings, as well as Evelyn's former home, reveals the existence of the Pact of the Black Tide, an ancient magic that allows one to alter reality in exchange for a personal sacrifice.

Clara must travel the world to discover how her aunt was involved with the Black Tide, find its source, and help her mother.

Pact of the Black Tide is an homage to classic point-and-click adventure games, blending ingenious puzzles and humor to take you to unknown and mysterious places.

You'll traverse three unique biomes, each with its own distinct atmosphere, and dozens of locations populated by memorable characters. All this unfolds within a graphically stunning world, boasting meticulous art direction. The witty and engaging writing will complete your immersion in its unique universe.
summary: A narrative point-and-click adventure game blending puzzles and wit. Explore, interact with a cast of colorful characters, combine items, and manipulate reality through an integrated magic system. Humor, adventure, and discovery await to bring you into new and unexpected worlds.
